Any loyal 9to5Toys reader knows our love for the Nomad brand. For years, the brand has been producing some of the best iPhone cases in the industry, and the all-new iPhone 18 Pro series this year is no exception. However, discounts are usually unavailable in the first few months after a new device launch — unless you use our exclusive Nomad promo code. Enter 9TO5MAC at checkout to get 15% off any new iPhone 18 Pro case from the brand.

Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Cases — Exclusive Discount Code

***Note: Enter promo code 9TO5MAC at checkout to receive the following exclusive discounted pricing. Only iPhone 18 Pro/Max cases are eligible here; this does not include the iPhone Duo.

  • Modern Camino Leather Case — $58 (regularly $69)
  • Modern Horween Leather Case — $67 (regularly $79)
  • Traditional Camino Leather Case — $67 (regularly $79)
  • Traditional Horween Leather Case — $75 (regularly $89)
  • Mag Leather Back — $50 (regularly $59)
  • Rugged Case — $58 (regularly $69)
  • Clear Leather Case — $58 (regularly $69)
  • Sport Case — $46 (regularly $55)

A quick reminder that buying most Nomad cases right now also lets you add a screen protector to the cart at 20% off — just remember to add it to the same cart.

I've been a huge fan of Nomad's Traditional Leather Case, with the leather wrapping extending around the sides of the case, and the two-tone Modern Leather models are equally excellent. This year I also got to try the limited-edition Bordeaux special edition that pairs perfectly with the iPhone 18 Pro — as usual, it's incredibly well made.

The brand has also rolled out an all-new Rugged Case lineup this year, featuring a topographic-map-inspired design based on the terrain of Baja California. It looks even better in person than it does on the website:

To learn more about the 2026 Nomad iPhone 18 Pro lineup, check out our hands-on coverage — and bring the discount code above with you when you go.
